findings.claim: Twilio Q1 2026 coverage: voice AI drove fastest growth in three years and FY revenue forecast raised; per search summary Q2 FY2026 coverage cited self-serve voice (AI-native entry point) growing >50% y/y. Sources do not analyze long-term durability; AI-native accounts described as small but high-growth cohort.
findings.source: The Next Web: Twilio raises full-year revenue forecast as voice AI drives fastest growth in three years

findings.claim: Infrastructure software (e.g., Twilio per-message) uses consumption pricing vs seat-based application SaaS; commentary argues AI agents threaten seat-based software, not usage-based. Opinion-level source.
findings.source: Nasdaq index presentation NQRPCI / SaaS pricing commentary

note: Only 2 of 4 searches used; no structural-vs-cyclical shortage/oversupply source or consensus 2027-28 demand figure found for the sector. as_of for second finding is estimated.
